versions.content: Purpose of AbstractValueRestriction The Abstract- ValueRestriction defines constraints on the value space of a simple primitive data type. The attributes of this class represent constraining facets according to the XML 80 of 497  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 202: AUTOSAR_TPS_GenericStructureTemplate Generic Structure Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Schema Specification [10]. A value is valid if it is valid according to all defined con- straints.
